Unchanged, and specifically re-checked post-#140/#141: STATE column stays live at the fast 2s cadence after #140 split cost onto its own slow ticker (confirmed: estate:build-5 changed free->busy between a 2s and a 10s capture). MODE column reads 'local' for every row via #141's new execution_mode decode/fallback path -- but the field itself is not yet emitted anywhere: agent-supervisor's live checkout has no execution_mode in lanes.sh (agent-supervisor#534, the daemon-side emitter, is still blocked by the authorship gate and unmerged), so every row is resolving through the OLD Command/State fallback, not genuinely exercising #141's new field-based path. COULD NOT MEASURE the 'container' arm (no AgentBox driver exists anywhere in this estate) or a genuine field-sourced 'local'/'unknown' distinction (the field is dormant) -- both arms are synthetic/unverifiable against live data until #534 merges; #141's own unit tests already mutation-check the decode logic itself, not re-derived here. COST column reads 'unknown' for every row through a 25s hold -- confirmed this is honest degradation, not a #140 regression: every estate:* lane's harness_session_id is empty in the live ledger (queried directly), which buildAgentCostFetch's own early-return ('no lane has a resolved harness session id yet') already treats as a real zero-cost-rows state, independent of the fetch cadence.
